Load tools 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rtracklayer)
library(ggplot2)
library(gggenes)
library(ggforce)
library(stringr)
library(magrittr)
```

#===============================================================================
# 1. Read Input Data and Standardise PAF column names
#===============================================================================

```{r readData}
fullDat <- readxl::read_xlsx("../all_vs_allNLRGeneSeqs_chr5B_Loc1_17PGs+Tsn1_with_identity.xlsx", sheet = 4, col_names = TRUE)
```


```{r}
glimpse(fullDat)
```

Check that we don't have any duplicate col names

```{r}
names(fullDat)
nrow(fullDat)
```

rename required useful columns

```{r}
paf <- fullDat %>% dplyr::rename(
    qname = query_name,
    tname = target_name,
    pid = alignment_identity_percent,
    qcov_percent = query_coverage_percent,
    tcov_percent = target_coverage_percent,
    reciprocal_cov_percent = reciprocal_coverage_percent) 
```


```{r}
paf %<>% dplyr::mutate(
    qcov = qcov_percent / 100,
    tcov = tcov_percent / 100,
    reciprocal_cov = reciprocal_cov_percent / 100,
    class = case_when(
      pid == 100 & qcov >= 0.99 & tcov >= 0.99 ~ "identical",
      pid >= 99  & qcov >= 0.99 & tcov >= 0.99 ~ "similar",
      pid >= 85  & qcov >= 0.85 & tcov >= 0.85 ~ "partial",
      TRUE ~ "weak"))
```

#===============================================================================
# 2. Build gene lookup tables from orthogroup assignment table
#===============================================================================
Read in the gene table

```{r}
nlrDat <- readxl::read_xlsx("2026_July_09_allGenomesNLRGenes.xlsx", sheet = 1, col_names = T)
glimpse(nlrDat)
```

Make gene order from existing coordinates
```{r}
# Make gene order from existing coordinates
nlrDat2 <- nlrDat %>%
  mutate(
    gene_start = as.numeric(gene_start),
    gene_end   = as.numeric(gene_end)
  ) %>%
  group_by(genome) %>%
  arrange(gene_start, gene_end, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(geneorder = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()
```


```{r}
gene_lookup1 <- nlrDat2 %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    gene1 = geneID,
    genome1 = genome,
    gene_chrom1 = gene_chrom,
    gene_start1 = gene_start,
    gene_end1 = gene_end,
    geneorder1 = geneorder,
    gene_strand1 = gene_strand,
    orthogroup1 = orthogroup
  )

gene_lookup2 <- nlrDat2 %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    gene2 = geneID,
    genome2 = genome,
    gene_chrom2 = gene_chrom,
    gene_start2 = gene_start,
    gene_end2 = gene_end,
    gene_strand2 = gene_strand,
    geneorder2 = geneorder,
    orthogroup2 = orthogroup
  )
```

Focal genome
```{r}
focal_genome <- "WATDE0042"
```

#===============================================================================
# 3. Attach genome/orthogroup information to PAF hits
#===============================================================================


remove the LC genes from Kariega

```{r}
paf <- paf %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !(stringr::str_detect(qname, "KAR") & stringr::str_detect(qname, "LC")),
    !(stringr::str_detect(tname, "KAR") & stringr::str_detect(tname, "LC"))
  )

nrow(paf)
```


```{r}

hits0 <- paf %>%
  filter(qname != tname) %>%
  inner_join(gene_lookup1, by = c("qname" = "gene1")) %>%
  inner_join(gene_lookup2, by = c("tname" = "gene2")) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(orthogroup1),
    !is.na(orthogroup2),
    orthogroup1 == orthogroup2
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    orthogroup = orthogroup1,
    direction_id = paste(qname, tname, sep = "__"),
    reverse_id   = paste(tname, qname, sep = "__"),
    pair_id = map2_chr(
      qname,
      tname,
      ~ paste(sort(c(.x, .y)), collapse = "__")
    ),
    similarity_score = pid * reciprocal_cov
  )

# Keep only hits where the reverse alignment also exists
directed_ids <- hits0 %>%
  distinct(direction_id)
```

#===============================================================================
# 4. Keep one best reciprocal link per unordered gene pair
#===============================================================================


```{r}
reciprocal_links <- hits0 %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    reciprocal_cov >= 0.85,
    pid >= 85
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    pair_id,
    dplyr::desc(similarity_score),
    dplyr::desc(pid),
    dplyr::desc(reciprocal_cov)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(pair_id) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()
```

#===============================================================================
# 5. Keep only links between focal genome and the other genomes
#===============================================================================

```{r}

focal_links <- reciprocal_links %>%
  filter(genome1 == focal_genome | genome2 == focal_genome)
```

#===============================================================================
# 6. Order genomes by similarity to focal genome
#===============================================================================

```{r}
similarity_order <- focal_links %>%
  mutate(
    other_genome = if_else(genome1 == focal_genome, genome2, genome1)
  ) %>%
  group_by(other_genome) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_pid = mean(pid, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_reciprocal_cov = mean(reciprocal_cov, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_similarity_score = mean(similarity_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_reciprocal_links = n(),
    n_orthogroups = n_distinct(orthogroup),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(mean_similarity_score),
    desc(n_reciprocal_links),
    desc(mean_pid)
  )

# Focal genome at the bottom: y = 1
# Most similar genome directly above it: y = 2
genome_order <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    genome = focal_genome,
    y = 1,
    mean_similarity_score = NA_real_,
    n_reciprocal_links = NA_integer_
  ),
  similarity_order %>%
    transmute(
      genome = other_genome,
      y = row_number() + 1,
      mean_similarity_score,
      n_reciprocal_links
    )
)

# Optional: include genomes with no reciprocal hits, placed at the top
missing_genomes <- setdiff(unique(nlrDat$genome), genome_order$genome)

if (length(missing_genomes) > 0) {
  genome_order <- bind_rows(
    genome_order,
    tibble(
      genome = missing_genomes,
      y = max(genome_order$y) + seq_along(missing_genomes),
      mean_similarity_score = NA_real_,
      n_reciprocal_links = 0L
    )
  )
}
```

#===============================================================================
# 7. Prepare genes for plotting
#===============================================================================

```{r}

genes_plot <- nlrDat2 %>%
  inner_join(genome_order, by = "genome") %>%
  mutate(
    xmin = geneorder - 0.45,
    xmax = geneorder + 0.45
  )
```

#===============================================================================
# 8. Orient reciprocal links from focal genome upward
#===============================================================================

```{r}

links_to_plot <- focal_links %>%
  mutate(
    focal_gene = if_else(genome1 == focal_genome, qname, tname),
    other_gene = if_else(genome1 == focal_genome, tname, qname),

    focal_geneorder = if_else(genome1 == focal_genome, geneorder1, geneorder2),
    other_geneorder = if_else(genome1 == focal_genome, geneorder2, geneorder1),

    other_genome = if_else(genome1 == focal_genome, genome2, genome1),

    y_focal = 1
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    genome_order %>% select(other_genome = genome, y_other = y),
    by = "other_genome"
  )
```

#===============================================================================
# 9. Plot reciprocal focal-genome microsynteny figure
#===============================================================================

```{r}
og_colors <- c(
  "OG0000052" = "#0072B2",  # blue
  "OG0000004" = "#E69F00",  # orange
  "OG0000028" = "#009E73",  # bluish green
  "OG0000019" = "#CC79A7",  # reddish purple
  "OG0000054" = "#D55E00",  # vermillion
  "OG0000051" = "#56B4E9",  # sky blue
  "OG0000003" = "#F0E442",  # yellow
  "OG0000010" = "#332288",  # dark purple
  "OG0000030" = "#88CCEE",  # light blue
  "OG0000017" = "#44AA99",  # teal
  "OG0000047" = "#117733",  # dark green
  "OG0000026" = "#882255",  # wine
  "OG0000034" = "#AA4499",  # purple-pink
  "OG0000053" = "#DDCC77",  # sand
  "OG0000042" = "#999933"   # olive
)

p <- ggplot() +

  geom_curve(
    data = links_to_plot,
    aes(
      x = focal_geneorder,
      y = y_focal,
      xend = other_geneorder,
      yend = y_other,
      color = class
    ),
    curvature = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.55,
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +

  geom_gene_arrow(
    data = genes_plot,
    aes(
      xmin = xmin,
      xmax = xmax,
      y = y,
      forward = gene_strand == "+",
      fill = orthogroup
    ),
    arrowhead_height = unit(2.5, "mm"),
    arrow_body_height = unit(2.5, "mm"),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = genome_order$y,
    labels = genome_order$genome,
    limits = c(0.5, max(genome_order$y) + 0.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(
      0,
      ceiling(max(genes_plot$xmax, na.rm = TRUE)),
      by = 5
    ),
    name = "Gene order within locus"
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      identical = "#1f78b4",
      similar = "#00BFFF",
      partial = "#ff7f00",
      weak = "grey70"
    )
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
  values = og_colors,
  na.value = "white",
  drop = FALSE) +

  labs(
    title = paste0("Reciprocal NLR similarity links to ", focal_genome),
    subtitle = "Rows ordered upward by similarity to focal genome",
    color = "PAF class",
    fill = "Orthogroup"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 13),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )

p
```
